title: Round-Robin Lock — last_gnt Not Reset, Combinational Logic Incomplete
bug_signature: UVM_ERROR: [XZ] last_gnt=1'bx after reset; round-robin rotation indeterminate
expected_root_cause: The last_gnt register has no reset branch so it is 1'bx at power-on; additionally the combinational next-grant logic has only one conditional branch leaving next_gnt undriven for all other master combinations, producing X on the grant bus.
description: The last_gnt pointer is not reset on rst_n, starting as 1'bx; the combinational next-grant logic only checks one condition and has no else branch, leaving the arbiter in an indeterminate rotation state after reset.
failure_log: UVM_ERROR: [XZ] last_gnt=1'bx after reset; round-robin rotation indeterminate
success_log: last_gnt=1'b0 after reset. Round-robin alternates correctly between masters.
